/* SeparateMngMapper.selectSeparateDocList : 별도관리물품해제신고 제출번호 그룹 List */
SELECT edi.EDI_DOC_NO ,edi.EDI_SEND_DATE ,edi.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,edi.OD_JOB_NO ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL WHERE SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO = edi.EDI_DOC_NO) AS DOC_CNT ,ISNULL(edi.EDI_STATUS, 'EDI') AS EDI_STATUS ,CASE WHEN edi.EDI_STATUS IN ('READY','SEND','RECV','1','3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SEND_CNT ,od.CUSTOMS_CODE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.MRN ,od.MSN FROM TB_EDI_LINKED edi INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON edi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE edi.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND edi.EDI_CODE = 'GOVCBRDAX'
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})

/* SeparateMngMapper.selectSpecialData : 별도관리물품해제신고 생성자료 조회 */ SELECT ad.SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO ,ad.HBL_NO ,ad.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,ad.OD_JOB_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,(SELECT EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_ECM WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode} AND SEQ_NO = ad.EDI_MAILBOX_SEQ_NO) AS EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID
,edi.EDI_JOB_NO ,edi.EDI_STATUS
FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_EDI_LINKED edi ON edi.EDI_DOC_NO = ad.SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO
WHERE ad.SPECIAL_ITEM_DOC_NO IN(#{item.ediDocNo})
WHERE ad.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo})

/* SeparateMngMapper.getSeparateDocNo : 별도관리물품해제신고 추출 배송지변경 번호: 특송부호(6) +년도(4) +일련번호(8) TODO 특송부호 prefix 받아야함*/ SELECT CONCAT('BBCDEF',CONVERT(CHAR(4), GETDATE(), 112),CONCAT(REPLICATE('0', 8 - LEN(num)), num)) AS ediDocNo FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SUBSTRING(EDI_DOC_NO,11,8)),0) + 1 AS num FROM TB_EDI_LINKED WHERE SUBSTRING(EDI_DOC_NO,1,10) = CONCAT('BBCDEF',CONVERT(CHAR(4), GETDATE(), 112)) ) A
